correctness.rationale: The merged labels are precisely the greedy ternary digits of y. For a.e. y the points v_n=3^n y mod 2 are equidistributed on [0,2); this follows from ergodicity of tripling on the doubled circle and remains true for a.e. y in its subinterval [0,1). The recurrence gives x_n=z+v_n/2 mod 1 and y_n={v_n}, where z={x-y/2}. Sheet j=0,1 therefore supplies a dense set of comparisons {s+t/2}<3t with s={z+j/2}. Before wrap the comparison opens at 2s/5; on wrap it is true, giving threshold min(2s/5,2(1-s)). Taking the first label-0 infimum on each dense return set, or 1/3 if that label is absent, handles the maximum threshold and all equality conventions. Two distinct equal first thresholds force z'=1-z/5 with z<5/6<z'. Comparing the translated thresholds on z<1/3, 1/3<=z<1/2, and z>=1/2 gives only the nontrivial pair 5/12,11/12. The excluded fibers and atypical base orbits are Haar-null. Independently the Haar-preserving, piecewise-affine measurable conjugacy a={2x-y}, b={x-a/2} with inverse x={b+a/2}, y={2b}, gives (a,b)->(a,{3b}), entropy log 3 and nonergodicity. A generating three-letter name at that entropy must have entropy n log 3 for every length-n block and hence be uniform i.i.d., an ergodic process; fewer letters violate the entropy bound. value.rationale: An optimal alphabet with a single straight cut of one of the original digit strips preserves direct access to the natural expanding coordinate. The doubled-circle decoder shows how this coarser geometric constraint can still retain the neutral sheet information, which a partition pulled back through the natural two-to-one factor cannot retain. The value is in this concrete simple coding and its decoder, not in a new entropy theorem, a general classification or a claim about Markov coding.
